title: entropy-weighted-version-suggester-and-annotated-changelog-context
author: Priya Desai
release_notes: Add entropy-weighted version suggestion service and annotated changelog context generator. Improves automated semantic version recommendations during model onboarding and generates human-readable rationales for release notes. Backwards-compatible; defaults disabled behind feature flag.
description: Motivation: When onboarding or rolling a new model variant we often have to pick a semantic version bump (patch/minor/major) and write release notes that explain impact. That process is manual, brittle, and sometimes inconsistent across teams. This PR introduces two complementary features: (1) an entropy-weighted version suggester that synthesizes signals from usage distributions, eval deltas, and profile stability to recommend a semantic version bump and a concise rationale; (2) an annotated changelog context generator that crafts short human-readable explanations (1-3 lines) for release notes by pulling commit summaries, telemetry deltas, and affected-model-profile anchors. Scope: model registry service + onboarding CLI + small UI metadata helpers. Design notes: the suggester computes three weighted signals: signal_entropy (how much usage patterns changed across routes/cohorts), perf_delta (normalized latency/cost/quality deltas from baseline profiles), and stability_anchor_shift (how many profile anchors moved outside tolerance). We map a composite score to semantic bump thresholds with tunable margins. The changelog contexter aggregates: the highest-impact commits (by footprint in changed artifacts), top telemetry deltas, and the suggested bump rationale into a single annotated line. Checklist: - [x] core scorer implementation and normalization - [x] onboarding CLI flag --auto-suggest-version - [x] changelog context writer that emits draft note to /onboard/drafts - [x] unit tests for scorer thresholds and context formatting - [x] e2e smoke run against staging model-catalog - [x] feature-flag gated rollout and telemetry metric (registry.version_suggestions.accepted) Backwards compatibility: All behavior is behind registry feature flag 'entropy_version_suggester'. Default remains manual. Rollout plan: land behind flag, enable for small cohort of internal teams for 2 weeks, gather accept/override rate and iterate thresholds. Metrics to watch: suggestion_accept_rate, suggested_bump_distribution, time_saved_per_onboard, churn_after_rollout. Related: ENG-2048 (onboard UX improvements), PM-674 (release notes automation).
commits: 3 commits: 1) feat(suggester): add entropy-weighted scorer and thresholds (Priya) 2) feat(changelog): annotated changelog context aggregator and CLI hook (Evan) 3) test(docs): add unit/e2e tests and docs for feature flag (Liu)
